docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Smith's first book: how sympathy, the impartial spectator and the sense of duty make human beings moral, before The Wealth of Nations.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Adam Smith (1723–1790), The Theory of Moral Sentiments, 1759 (sixth edition, 1790). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
